title: Serenity
description: Enjoy the world with serene landscapes and peaceful play. A modpack crafted and polished for relaxing gameplay.
body:
🌸 Serenity : Build like never before

# Serenity Means Peace
Have you ever been playing Minecraft but felt like the world feels uninviting? The night is too hostile to relax, caves are frightening, and creepers ruin your builds. Yet when you go to peaceful, you miss out on many opportunities where you need mobs for loot. The goal of serenity is to solve this, whilst doing much, **much** more.

### Developing Peaceful Gameplay
In Serenity, mobs aren't removed. Yet they are neutral to the player. Don't attack them, and they won't attack you. Traverse the overworld without a concern for mobs. The surface is mob-free, and underground you're still safe!

But peacefulness isn't just about mobs. It's about environment. Serenity adds a number of environmental mods, with breathtaking landscapes to make every frame a painting. Fog fills the atmosphere. Peaceful critters decorate the surface. Rain is prettier and sounds better. Biomes are larger to not have such quick, distracting biome changes.

Peacefulness is also about improving Minecraft's more peaceful activities. Fishing has been overhauled to resemble Stardew Valley's fishing minigames. There are far more fish to catch. A number of mods have been added to bring more life to horses. Noteblocks have been expanded to include more instruments, and you can play literal instruments! Numerous new foods are available to cook and eat! And theres so much more!

### Building your Serenity
Serenity's core gameplay is building. Villages have been completely removed to revamp the surface into a world of your own. Only old, ancient structures remain, ruins of those who came before you. It's your turn to build a story.

Assisted by dozens of new mods catered towards building and aesthetics, you can build anything in any style with plenty of choices. Build whatever you dream of. Your own serene builds are the key to peace in this modpack! Whether it's a simple house, or a towering mansion, build it all!

Serenity will have continued, long-term support, to continue expanding on the possibilities present in the pack, and polishing to create more peaceful gameplay. A relaxing experience, and a fun, polished one, is the most important goal of this pack! I'm actively commissioning and planning mods for all these goals to be achieved. Current plans are overhauls for fishing, enchanting, and villager trades.


### What Serenity Isn't

Serenity is not a tech modpack, nor is it a Vanilla+ modpack. Tech is mostly present only from Create and its add-ons that in this pack serve as an aesthetic above all else. Automation is simply a medium to gain resources for building. It is not a Vanilla+ modpack as it overhauls many systems that becomes an experience that sets itself apart from Vanilla. If you are looking for either of these experiences, this modpack is not for you. This modpack does not have goals, you create those yourself!

_Runs on 4GB of ram. 6GB is highly recommended._
